allow_instructions: Allow git commands that do not create a commit or publish to a remote, including status, diff, log, show, add, restore, checkout, switch, branch, fetch, pull, stash, remote, and similar workspace git operations.
block_instructions: Always require approval for git commit (including --amend, -m, and empty commits) and git push (including force push, push --tags, and any push to a remote). Never auto-run those.
